MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Fjord Embolization Coil System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of 1.5-Tesla
· Maximum spatial field gradient of 1000 gauss/cm (10 T/m) or less
· maximum B1+rms of 2.4 µT; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 2 W/kg
· Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Fjord Embolization Coil System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
